sections.text_helper: Section 40.9.11 "CSI-2 Host watchdog register (CSI_WDR)" in chapter 40 (CSI-2 Host (CSI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2053.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x78
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:0 CNT[31:0]: Watchdog counter
These bits contains the maximum number of clock cycles (clk_proc) between an EOF and a
SOF for a given channel before triggering an interrupt if WDERRIE=1 in CSI_IER0.
The value 0x000000 disables the watchdog counter.
